title: ThinkingTypes

adaptive.description: Whether the model accepts thinking with type 'adaptive' (the model decides whether and how much to think).

between_tools.description: Whether the model accepts thinking with type 'between_tools' (thinking turned off, and any short progress updates the model writes between tool calls come back as thinking blocks). False exactly when a request that sends it gets a 400 from this model. A request that sends 'between_tools' can still be rejected for another reason, such as an effort level the model does not allow with thinking off.

disabled.description: Whether the model accepts thinking with type 'disabled' (thinking turned off). False exactly when a request that sends it gets a 400 from this model. True on a model that does not support thinking. A request that sends 'disabled' can still be rejected for another reason, such as an effort level the model does not allow with thinking off.

enabled.description: Whether the model accepts thinking with type 'enabled' (extended thinking with a caller-set `budget_tokens`).

description: Which `thinking.type` values the model accepts on requests. Read each key on its own: for example, `enabled` can be false while `disabled` is true.
